summary: Sandbach United fought back from a goal down to earn a 1-1 draw against New Mills in their opening fixture, with an own goal helping them level the score in the second half. The match was competitive but scrappy, with New Mills dominating possession and dangerous on the counter-attack, while Sandbach will feel they can improve their performance going forward. A red card for number 4 added to the drama late in the game as both sides settled for a point.
